unknown_objects: All hidden Q^j, hidden state identities and count, microscopic gain values, occupation submeasures

supplied_representations.controller: Executable causal map from visible history and exogenous seed to a finite action index
supplied_representations.predictor: Executable causal map returning a bounded nonnegative visible hazard vector, frozen before validation
supplied_representations.probe_library: Reproducible physical settings indexed by (j,u) and (j,u,v), with stated microscopic gain product law and rate bound
supplied_representations.preparation: Fresh reset/replay before each raw nodal mean; counterfactual equality is in distribution, not microscopic cloning

acquired_output.Dcert: Scalar upper bound on D valid on a simultaneous moment confidence event
acquired_output.failure: inconclusive if synthesis, precision, model or preparation gates do not close

forbidden_shortcuts: Hidden Q access used as estimator input
Sequential pulse confused with product setting
A tiny training residual substituted for on-policy occupation
Fitted policy changed after validation without new trials
Finite numerical zero treated as population equality
status: candidate interface; physical acquisition and priority open
